rows.summary: People say this place offers clean kayaks and paddleboards, along with easy online signup and check-in systems. Visitors also highlight the reasonable prices and the helpful, knowledgeable staff who provide excellent guidance. They also mention the convenient beachside rental and launch area.

rows.name: Tahoe Dave's Skis & Boards
rows.summary: People say this ski rental shop offers a wide selection of well-maintained gear and provides quick, efficient service. They also highlight the knowledgeable and accommodating staff who ensure proper fittings and helpful advice. Visitors appreciate the significantly cheaper prices compared to resort rentals.

rows.name: Tahoe Donner Beach Club Marina
rows.summary: This recreational beach offers access for boaters, plus stand-up paddling, swimming & windsurfing.

rows.name: Tahoe Ebikes
rows.summary: People say this bicycle rental service offers a wide variety of bikes, including mountain bikes, e-bikes, and street bikes, and provides access to local trails. They highlight the knowledgeable staff, helpful maintenance services, and problem-free rental experience. They also like the friendly and generous staff who share trail knowledge.

rows.name: Tahoe Family Adventures
rows.summary:
Some people say this snowmobile rental service can't be relied on for boat rentals.

Other reviews mention customer service can be poor and communication can be unprofessional.

rows.name: Tahoe Mountain Sports
rows.summary: People say this outdoor sports store offers a great selection of gear and clothing, including Nordic skis, boots, and backcountry equipment. They highlight the knowledgeable and helpful staff, and the friendly and welcoming vibe. They also like the reasonable prices and quality of the products.

rows.name: Tahoe Paradise Boat Rentals
rows.summary: People say this boat rental service offers well-maintained boats in excellent condition, perfect for enjoying Lake Tahoe's stunning views. They also highlight the incredibly friendly and helpful staff, who ensure a smooth and organized experience. Guests mention the option to book a captain, providing a stress-free VIP experience to hidden beaches.

rows.name: Tahoe Sports Hub
rows.summary: Store offering gear, apparel & rentals for skiing, snowboarding, paddle sports, camping & climbing. People say this sporting goods store offers a great selection of skis, snowboards, mountain bikes, boots, and gear. They highlight the personalized boot fitting experience, the knowledgeable and helpful staff, and the competitive prices for rentals and demos. They also like the friendly and welcoming atmosphere.

rows.name: Tahoe Sports Ltd.
rows.summary:
Visitors say this store offers a wide selection of gear for various outdoor activities, including ski, snowboard, and climbing, and provides excellent repair services. They also highlight the knowledgeable and helpful staff, who offer great advice and go above and beyond to assist customers.

Some reviews mention the service can be unprofessional.

rows.name: Tahoe Sports Ski Run Boat Company
Tahoe Sports Tahoe Keys Boat Rental
rows.summary:
Reviewers consistently praise this boat rental company for its smooth process for both boats and kayaks. Customers also appreciate the friendly and accommodating staff, reasonable prices, and the thorough explanations provided.

Some reviews mention the service can be poor.

rows.name: Tahoe Via Ferrata
rows.summary: People say this via ferrata offers a challenging yet safe climbing experience with stunning views, suitable for all skill levels, including beginners. Visitors highlight the knowledgeable and supportive guides who ensure safety and make the adventure fun. They also appreciate the option of 2-hour or 4-hour tours, with many recommending the longer option for a more complete experience.

rows.name: Tahoe Waterman's Landing
rows.summary: Beachfront cafe offering coffee, beer & healthy snacks, plus stand-up paddleboards for rent. People say this coffee shop serves up delicious breakfast burritos and chai tea lattes, and they praise the stunning views of Lake Tahoe. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, and the overall peaceful and welcoming atmosphere.

rows.name: The BackCountry
rows.summary: Shoppers say this bicycle store offers a wide variety of backcountry gear, including splitboard setups, climbing equipment, and mountain bikes, and they praise the friendly and knowledgeable staff who provide excellent customer service. They also highlight the quick turnaround time for bike repairs and the helpful advice for choosing the right gear.

rows.name: The Home Depot
rows.summary:
Chain home improvement retailer for tools, appliances & other products (some offer truck rentals). Customers consistently praise this hardware store for its wide variety of products and well-stocked shelves, which simplifies finding necessary project materials. Reviewers also frequently mention the friendly staff who are readily available to assist shoppers.

Some reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.

rows.name: The Ski Renter
rows.summary: People say this ski rental service offers high-quality skis, boots, and poles, with options to buy used equipment. They highlight the affordable prices, especially for season-long rentals, and the flexible rental terms, allowing for unused days to be credited. They also like the friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable staff.

rows.name: The Village Board Shop
rows.summary: People say this board shop offers a great selection of gear, accessories, and clothes, including custom hats, and provides excellent repair and tuning services. They also highlight the affordable prices and the welcoming, friendly atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are knowledgeable, helpful, and provide outstanding service.

rows.name: TrailersPlus
rows.summary: People say this trailer dealer offers a wide selection of trailers and financing options. They highlight the quick and efficient purchase process, and the professional and knowledgeable staff. They also like the friendly and helpful service.

rows.name: Truckee River Raft Co.
rows.summary: People say this rafting company offers a fun and easy float down the river, perfect for families. They highlight the convenient parking, easy check-in process, and short wait times for shuttles and rafts. They also like the friendly and helpful staff, and the well-maintained equipment.

rows.name: Truckee River Rafting
rows.summary: People say this river rafting experience offers a relaxing and scenic float with just enough rapids at the end to make it exciting. Visitors also highlight the convenient shuttle services and the ability to stop and swim or snack along the route. They also mention the friendly and professional staff.

rows.name: U-Haul Trailer Hitch Super Center at Virginia St
U-Haul at Oddie Blvd
rows.summary:
People say this moving supply store has helpful, friendly, and professional staff who provide quick service, and that the equipment is clean and well-maintained.

Other reviews mention reservations can be unhonored and the online system can be unreliable.

rows.name: Velo Reno
rows.summary: People say this bicycle store offers a wide variety of bikes, parts, and accessories, with friendly and knowledgeable staff who are passionate about cycling. They also highlight the excellent customer service and helpfulness of the staff, who go above and beyond to assist customers.

rows.name: Village Ski Loft
rows.summary: People say this ski store offers efficient ski and snowboard rentals, with staff who work tirelessly to ensure the perfect fit for all skill levels. They also highlight the incredibly kind, helpful, and accommodating staff who provide excellent customer service.

rows.name: Virginia City off road Experience
rows.summary: People say this tourist attraction offers an adventurous off-road experience with beautiful views and opportunities to explore historic sites and mines. They highlight the knowledgeable tour guides, the fun and thrilling ride, and the memorable experience. They also like the friendly and accommodating staff.

rows.name: Vista Trail Bikes
rows.summary: People say this bike rental shop offers high-quality, well-maintained e-bikes that make riding the scenic East Shore Trail effortless, even on inclines. Visitors highlight the stunning lake views and convenient access to beaches like Sand Harbor. They also appreciate the friendly, knowledgeable staff who provide helpful instructions, maps, and practical tips.

rows.name: Watta Bike Shop
rows.summary: People say this bicycle store offers a wide selection of bikes, parts, and accessories, and provides fast and affordable repairs. They highlight the reasonable prices and convenient location near bike paths. They also like the friendly and helpful service.

rows.name: Winter Wonderland Ski Shop
rows.summary: People say this ski store offers great prices on rentals and helpful staff who can assist with waxing and board maintenance. They also highlight the friendly and quick service, convenient parking, and knowledgeable team.

rows.name: Zephyr Cove Marina
rows.summary: People say this marina offers boat rentals, kayaking, and a beach area. They highlight the beautiful views, crystal clear water, and the option to bring dogs on boat rentals. They also like the friendly and helpful staff, and the easy rental process.

rows.name: evo Tahoe City
rows.summary: People say this store offers a wide selection of ski boots, clothes, and e-bikes, and provides repair kits and helmets with rentals. They also highlight the knowledgeable and helpful staff, who offer excellent service and guidance. Guests mention the great value and the convenient bar within the store.
